notes: ITU-T G.9807.1 Table B.9.3 (9.95328 Gbit/s downstream): OLT mean launched power +8.0..+11.0 dBm for class E2, ONU sensitivity -28.0 dBm. The 2023 edition's main body table splits E2 into E2a (+8..+12 dBm) and E2b (+14.5..+16.5 dBm); this part is the E2a variant quoting Table B.9.3. Class E2 assumes 20-35 dB of ODN loss (Table B.9.2), so an 8 dBm launch into a short test span arrives above the ONT overload point: attenuate, do not add reach.
